overview: This 402-page file traces industrial licensing before the war and the Allied occupation’s restructuring of Japanese business through 1949. State Department memoranda, SCAP directives, legislation, company orders, and press reports document debates over zaibatsu dissolution, deconcentration, antitrust reform, economic recovery, and foreign investment.
interest: Draft policies and case records reveal how U.S. officials narrowed deconcentration while weighing reform against Japan’s economic recovery.
